candidate_policy: Create a new candidate tree; preserve the broad semantic inventory and contract-tracing instructions while replacing model-authored evidence transcription and review-aware discovery.
input_policy: Reuse the exact five cases, two reviewer families, and ten frozen sample-1 base reviews. Run one review-blind discovery per case, then subtract independently against each frozen review.

diagnostic_only.known_description_miss: Track whether the review-blind discovery recovers the unreachable existing-description fallback defect; do not use one historical root cause as the sole gate.

stop_conditions.behavior: Any loss or unsupported candidate finding blocks fresh-PR work.
stop_conditions.mechanics: Below 70% full materialization or coverage completeness means redesign the interface instead of tuning the prompt.
stop_conditions.budget: Do not start fresh-PR evaluation from this run; the all-attempt replay budget is 35 USD.

decision_policy.behavior_failed: Park or diagnose semantic regressions before further spend.
decision_policy.behavior_passed_mechanics_failed: Keep the semantic candidate experimental and redesign the remaining mechanical boundary.
decision_policy.both_passed: Freeze V2 and advance to a small fresh-PR comparison.
